caption:
OpenAI has launched its Agents API as a public beta, allowing developers to create cloud-based agents that can run for hours and execute code. This API leverages the same infrastructure that powers Codex and ChatGPT, introducing features like automatic context management and parallel tool usage. Developers can utilize OpenAI-hosted sandboxes or partners like Cloudflare and Oracle without extra fees.
